newsitem.title: USA: Xpedite says buyout offer extended.
newsitem.headline: Xpedite says buyout offer extended.

text.p: Xpedite Systems Inc said in a statement Monday, that UBS Partners, Fenway Partners and certain members of the company's senior management have agreed to extend their offer to purchase Xpedite until 1700 EDT (2100 GMT) on July 16.

In return for the extension, Xpedite agreed not to talk with or solicit any further offers to buy the company and to reimburse the buyout group's reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred from the five day extention, it said.
The original buyout offer made on February 7 placed a purchase price of $22.50 for each Xpedite share.
Xpedite provides fax and electronic messaging distribution services.
